imageAnalysis.description: Promotional graphic from Port Charlottetown showing two cruise ship photographs stacked vertically. Large overlay text reads 'Two Ship Day' and 'OCTOBER 8'. On the top photo (white ship) a blue banner reads 'PEARL MIST' with '7:00AM - 11:00PM' shown. On the bottom photo (dark-hulled ship) a dark banner reads 'MEIN SCHIFF 1' with '7:00AM - 5:00PM' shown. The Port Charlottetown logo appears in the top-left corner. The image combines photographic visuals of the ships with clear, large event text and times.
imageAnalysis.relevanceToPost: Directly lists two ship visit events with specific times and date (October 8). This image provides the primary event information complementary to the post text.

imageComplexity.recommendationReason: Image is a photographic promotional poster with a few large, easily readable overlay text blocks (two ship names and times). No calendar grid or dense small text present, so calendar-tiling OCR is unnecessary.

stage1Validation.reason: The post contains extractable event information: both the post text and the image describe a 'Two Ship Day' on October 8 and the image explicitly lists two ship visit entries with times (Pearl Mist: 7:00 AM - 11:00 PM; Mein Schiff 1: 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM). This meets the criteria for valid events/schedule extraction. The image is a promotional poster with clear, large text and does not require calendar tiling to read the entries.
